Saving with just the link feels right, and I don’t want to have to type a title every time. But if I leave the title blank, I’d expect the app to automatically pick up the page’s real title rather than just repeat the link.

In the list, I’d like to see the title, a short description, tags, and a small site icon so I can recognize links quickly. The full link and saved date are useful but less important. Could you adjust the saving flow to fill in that page information automatically?
